usage: Design and document-format references only. No public utterance, benchmark attack or complaint narrative was copied or translated into a dataset row.
row_provenance: Every row remains AI-generated; source_refs identifies design references, not original public sample IDs.

banking77.title: PolyAI task-specific datasets / BANKING77
banking77.application: Varied short, contextual banking requests; use of intent categories to avoid treating every banking message as a single transfer template. No utterances imported.
banking77.limitations: Intent queries are not complete transaction workflows or bank policy. This source is not evidence that the new Vietnamese rows were written by humans.

multiwoz.title: MultiWOZ
multiwoz.license_observed: Top-level repository license: MIT; check the selected data version before redistributing actual data
multiwoz.application: Task context, follow-up corrections and varied numbers of user turns in a multi-domain setting; no dialogue copied or translated.
multiwoz.limitations: The original corpus is described as human-human dialogue. These newly created rows are not original MultiWOZ data and cannot inherit a human-authored label.

cfpb_complaints.title: CFPB Consumer Complaint Database
cfpb_complaints.license_observed: Official site states published complaint data is freely available to use, analyze and build on
cfpb_complaints.application: Business distinctions among payment disputes, reimbursements and corrected charges; no narrative or personal data imported.
cfpb_complaints.limitations: CFPB warns that complaints are not a statistical sample of all consumer experiences; no representativeness claim is made here.

injecagent.title: InjecAgent
injecagent.application: Separate direct harm and data-stealing intentions; model an outbound target action, not only an objectionable instruction.
injecagent.limitations: Already used by the project's existing evaluation. No test case, target wording or source sample reused. Research reference only.

agentdojo.title: AgentDojo
agentdojo.application: Workspace, email, collaboration and tool-result trust boundaries; benign outward communication paired with malicious egress intentions.
agentdojo.limitations: No suite task or injection text copied. These are project-native synthetic scenarios, not AgentDojo benchmark results.

stripe_invoices.title: Stripe: Integrate with the Invoicing API
stripe_invoices.license_observed: Documentation consulted for workflow; no documentation text or code redistributed as dataset rows
stripe_invoices.application: Realistic invoice states, line items, prior payments and approved partial adjustments; values converted into this project's USD/VND conventions.
stripe_invoices.limitations: The project's action payload is not the Stripe API schema; do not assume Stripe's smallest-currency-unit convention applies to refund.amount here.

drive_permissions.title: Google Drive API: Share files, folders, and drives
drive_permissions.application: Named recipients, least requested access and separation of released files from private folders. The local permission values remain view/comment/edit.
drive_permissions.limitations: The local ShareFileRequest is an adapter schema, not a literal Drive permissions.create request.
